entry.title: Bathing Enclosure — Yasnaya Polyana

groundCutout.basis: Flooded enclosure and approach stair only; dry bank landing and attachment ground stay intact.

terrainReference.basis: Retained Protomaps 20261020 / standard Mapzen 201x201 grid at 6m; outside-bank provider [-3,0] supplies 209.66014442236218m datum. Native pond 208.23155921915782m; model water -1.4285852032043636m and deck -1.0285852032043636m. Preserve the original DEM samples and native water/road geometry. Native hydrology clears coarse ground that obscures the mapped pond; model cuts cover only its flooded body and stair, not the dry bank landing or unrelated buildings. The seven steps reconcile the coarse bank height with the photo-led .4m water clearance. The nearby native path stops about 2m from the landing; no invented final path is supplied.
